title: Unified Carrier Registration (UCR) Annual Renewal
reference_docs: USDOT #3020432; www.ucr.gov; MCS-150 (Motor Carrier Identification Report); Unified Carrier Registration program
remarks: Registration period opens October 1; renewal due December 30 annually. Annual fee is set by the UCR program and varies (2020: $60.62; 2023: $42.22; 2024: $38.10; 2025: $47.37). Exos is a Private Motor Carrier (not For Hire). Review/update the MCS-150 every other year.
objective: renew Exos Aerospace's Unified Carrier Registration (UCR) annually so the company's USDOT registration remains active and in compliance
overview: UCR is an annual federal registration tied to the company USDOT number. The registration period opens October 1 and the renewal is due by December 30 each year. The annual fee is set by the UCR program and varies year to year (2020: $60.62; 2023: $42.22; 2024: $38.10; 2025: $47.37). Exos is a Private Motor Carrier (not a For Hire carrier). Key reference data: Website www.ucr.gov; USDOT Number 3020432; Due December 30 annually (period opens October 1); Carrier type Private Motor Carrier; MCS-150 reviewed and updated every other year (biennially).

tasks.name: Task 1 - Confirm timing and fee
steps: Confirm the registration window is open (opens October 1).
Confirm the current-year fee on the UCR site before paying.

tasks.name: Task 2 - Access the UCR system
steps: Re-enter the USDOT number when prompted a second time.
Open and review the Privacy and Terms and Conditions links (required to proceed).

tasks.name: Task 3 - Renew the registration
steps: Proceed to the page listing all previous registrations.
Select the current year and begin the renewal.
Review the MCS-150 and update if due (review every other year).
When asked for carrier type, select Private Motor Carrier (Exos is not a For Hire carrier).
Pay the fee and confirm the registration is complete.
